sources.title: PMC electoral ward (prabhag) boundaries, 2025 delimitation
sources.license: Public Domain per OpenCity CKAN metadata (no upstream dedication)

provenance.note: 41 prabhags of the 2025 delimitation used for the 2026 PMC election. Ward names are NOT in the boundary file - its only attribute is a float ward number - and are joined from PMC's 2026 election results, 41 of 41. PMC's separate 15 ADMINISTRATIVE ward offices are a different geography and are not this layer.

_source: OpenCity `pune-wards-info` (PMC Electoral Wards 2025) + PMC 2026 election results
_note: Vintage matters here: OpenCity carries seven PMC ward files spanning four delimitations (2012, 2017, 2022 draft, 2025). This is the 2025 one. The 2022 file is a 58-ward draft that never went to poll.
